# Test pe experimental compose command - component-based prompt engineering

# Initialize component library
exec pe experimental compose --library-init
stdout 'Component library initialized successfully!'
stdout 'Created directories:'
exists components
exists components/context

# Add components to library
exec pe experimental compose --add-component context.txt --category context
stdout 'Added component: context.txt'
exec pe experimental compose --add-component instruction.txt --category instruction
stdout 'Added component: instruction.txt'

# Basic composition
exec pe experimental compose context.txt instruction.txt examples.txt --output composed.txt
stdout 'Composing 3 components'
stdout 'Style: default'
stdout 'Composition complete'
exists composed.txt
exec grep 'Context:' composed.txt
exec grep 'Instructions:' composed.txt

# Style-specific composition
exec pe experimental compose components/ --style cot --output cot-prompt.txt
stdout 'Chain-of-thought composition'
stdout 'Added reasoning structure'
exec grep 'step by step' cot-prompt.txt

# Few-shot composition
exec pe experimental compose base.txt --style few-shot --examples examples.json --output few-shot.txt
stdout 'Few-shot composition'
stdout 'Injected 3 examples'
exec grep 'Example 1:' few-shot.txt

# Composition with optimization
exec pe experimental compose context.txt task.txt --optimize --target gpt-4
stdout 'Composing with optimization'
stdout 'Target model: gpt-4'
stdout 'Optimizing coherence'
stdout 'TextGrad optimization applied'

# Component validation
exec pe experimental compose context.txt incompatible.txt --validate
! stderr .
stdout 'Warning: Potential incompatibility detected'
stdout 'context.txt expects: general knowledge'
stdout 'incompatible.txt provides: specialized medical'

# List available components
exec pe experimental compose --list
stdout 'Available components:'
stdout '  context/'
stdout '    - general.txt'
stdout '    - technical.txt'
stdout '  instructions/'
stdout '    - analyze.txt'
stdout '  examples/'

# Composition with pe.mod file
exec pe experimental compose
stdout 'Loading pe.mod'
stdout 'Resolving dependencies'
stdout 'Downloading github.com/anthropic/helpful-harmless@v1.2.0'
stdout 'Composing from module requirements'

# Import from URL
exec pe experimental compose --import https://example.com/components.txtar
stdout 'Importing components'
stdout 'Added 5 components'

# Coherence analysis
exec pe experimental compose prompt1.txt prompt2.txt --coherence-check
stdout 'Coherence analysis:'
stdout 'Semantic similarity: 0.85'
stdout 'Style consistency: 0.92'
stdout 'No conflicts detected'

-- context.txt --
You are an AI assistant with expertise in software engineering.

-- instruction.txt --
Please analyze the following code and provide insights.

-- examples.txt --
Example: When analyzing Python code, consider performance and readability.

-- base.txt --
Base prompt for few-shot learning.

-- examples.json --
[
  {"input": "What is 2+2?", "output": "4"},
  {"input": "What is 5+5?", "output": "10"},
  {"input": "What is 3+3?", "output": "6"}
]

-- incompatible.txt --
Use specialized medical terminology and diagnosis procedures.

-- task.txt --
Analyze the given data and provide actionable insights.

-- pe.mod --
module myproject

pe 1.0

require (
	github.com/anthropic/helpful-harmless v1.2.0
	github.com/openai/best-practices v2.1.0
	github.com/google/tech-writing v1.0.0
)

replace github.com/openai/best-practices => ./local-overrides/best-practices

-- pe.sum --

-- prompt1.txt --
Analyze this text for sentiment.

-- prompt2.txt --
Determine the emotional tone of the provided text.
